dialogues.speaker: Eugenie
dialogues.text: Hmm, the fruit import negotiations went very well. Just a few more good games of Genius Invokation TCG and my trip to Mondstadt will be perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Eugenie
dialogues.text: I'm looking for someone to play with. Would you like to have a friendly match?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Eugenie
dialogues.text: Okay! Don't forget to visit my fruit stall if you're ever in the Court of Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Eugenie
dialogues.text: Fresh decks are more sweet and sour than Valberries! You must be surprised!

dialogues.speaker: Eugenie
dialogues.text: No! Absolutely not! You play like a Lavender Melon... It's impossible to get a grasp on how to play against you!
